authorizationPolicy.description: A simulated SWIFT message preview or status progression may only be applied while the acting session holds the payment:operate capability; previews never carry raw banking details or PII, only masked identifiers, sanitized reason codes, and safe copy.

latencyPolicy.description: Simulated SWIFT transmission and acknowledgement latency is bounded and clamped by the mock envelope layer; min_latency_ms and max_latency_ms are hints for deterministic demo behavior.

previewPolicy.description: Preview templates are deterministic and demo-safe. {ref} is a demo payment reference, {uetr} is a simulated UETR, {date} is an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), and {amount} is a formatted settlement amount. Field values are masked and never carry real routing instructions or account holder identity.

messageTypes.label: pacs.008 — FI to FI Customer Credit Transfer
messageTypes.description: A simulated customer credit transfer message routing funds toward the beneficiary bank on behalf of the ordering customer.

messageTypes.label: pacs.009 — Financial Institution Credit Transfer (Cover)
messageTypes.description: A simulated cover-payment message that settles the interbank leg between correspondents when a serial route is not used.

routeTypes.label: Serial route
routeTypes.description: Funds and payment instruction travel together through the correspondent chain; no separate cover message is required.

routeTypes.label: Cover route
routeTypes.description: The payment instruction (pacs.008) is sent directly to the beneficiary bank while a separate cover message (pacs.009) settles the interbank leg.

transmissionStatuses.label: Queued
transmissionStatuses.description: The message is composed and waiting to be transmitted to the network.

transmissionStatuses.label: Transmitted
transmissionStatuses.description: The message has been transmitted to the simulated SWIFT network and is awaiting acknowledgement.

transmissionStatuses.label: Acknowledged (ACK)
transmissionStatuses.description: The network positively acknowledged the message; it was accepted for onward delivery.

transmissionStatuses.label: Rejected (NAK)
transmissionStatuses.description: The network negatively acknowledged the message; it was rejected and not delivered.

transmissionStatuses.label: Repair required
transmissionStatuses.description: The message was returned for repair because of a correctable data issue and must be resubmitted.

reasonCodes.label: Transmitted
reasonCodes.description: The message was transmitted to the simulated network.

reasonCodes.label: Positive acknowledgement
reasonCodes.description: The network acknowledged the message and accepted it for delivery.

reasonCodes.label: Format rejection
reasonCodes.description: The message was rejected because it failed network format validation.

reasonCodes.label: Field rejection
reasonCodes.description: The message was rejected because a mandatory field was missing or malformed.

reasonCodes.label: Beneficiary repair
reasonCodes.description: The beneficiary details require correction before the message can be retransmitted.

reasonCodes.label: Correspondent repair
reasonCodes.description: The correspondent or routing details require correction before the message can be retransmitted.

reasonCodes.label: Network unavailable
reasonCodes.description: The simulated SWIFT network is temporarily unavailable and produced no result.

routeDeterminations.label: EUR-USD Serial Route Determination
routeDeterminations.description: A direct correspondent relationship exists, so the instruction travels serially and no separate cover message is required.

routeDeterminations.label: EUR-GBP Serial Route Determination
routeDeterminations.description: A direct correspondent relationship exists for the GBP leg, so the instruction travels serially with no cover message.

routeDeterminations.label: USD-EUR Cover Route Determination
routeDeterminations.description: The instruction is sent directly to the beneficiary bank while a separate pacs.009 cover message settles the interbank leg through the correspondent.

routeDeterminations.label: USD-GBP Cover Route Determination
routeDeterminations.description: No direct route is available, so a pacs.009 cover message accompanies the pacs.008 instruction to settle the interbank leg.

routeDeterminations.label: GBP-EUR Cover Route Determination
routeDeterminations.description: A pacs.009 cover message settles the interbank leg while the pacs.008 instruction reaches the beneficiary bank directly.

routeDeterminations.label: GBP-USD Serial Route Determination
routeDeterminations.description: A direct correspondent relationship exists for the USD leg, so the instruction travels serially with no cover message.

defaultRouteDetermination.label: Standard default route determination
defaultRouteDetermination.description: Fallback route applied when no specific pair matches; routes serially via a currency-appropriate correspondent and does not require a cover message.

next_step.title: Message acknowledged
next_step.body: The simulated SWIFT network acknowledged this pacs.008 message and accepted it for onward delivery.

next_step.title: Cover payment acknowledged
next_step.body: Both the pacs.008 instruction and the accompanying pacs.009 cover message were acknowledged by the simulated network.

next_step.title: Message rejected
next_step.body: The simulated network rejected this message because it failed format validation. No funds were moved — correct the message and retransmit.

next_step.title: Message rejected
next_step.body: The simulated network rejected this message because a mandatory field was missing or malformed. No funds were moved — correct the field and retransmit.

next_step.title: Beneficiary details need repair
next_step.body: The message was returned for repair because the beneficiary details require correction. Repair the details and retransmit.

next_step.title: Correspondent details need repair
next_step.body: The cover message was returned for repair because the correspondent or routing details require correction. Repair the routing and retransmit.

next_step.title: Network unavailable
next_step.body: The simulated SWIFT network is temporarily unavailable and produced no result. Wait a moment and try transmitting again.
